“Ah, a warrior. You'll want my finest.”
“Hello. Bring me coal and I'll treat you right.”
“Welcome. Nobody leaves my stall unprotected.”
“Hello! I've got a helmet with your name on it.”
“Greetings. Iron golems are jealous of my work.”
“Hello. Let's get you suited up.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_butcher: “Hello! Fresh meat, cut this morning.”
“Welcome. Hungry? Of course you are.”
“Ah, a customer. Pork chop? Steak?”
“Greetings! Bring me chickens and I'll pay you well.”
“Hello. Don't ask where the sausages come from.”
“Welcome to the best smoked meat in the village.”
“Hello! You look like you need a hearty meal.”
“Greetings. The smoker's been going all day.”
“Ah, hello. Mutton or rabbit stew today?”
“Hello! My cooked porkchops are famous.”
“Welcome. Mind the drips, I just cleaned the smoker.”
“Greetings, friend. Got any raw beef for me?”
“Hello. Nothing beats a good steak after a long day.”
“Ah, a meat lover. I can tell.”
“Hello! Rabbit stew, fresh and warm.”
“Welcome. Sweet berries? I'll take them.”
“Hello. The pigs aren't fond of me.”
“Greetings. Kelp? Bring me dried kelp blocks.”
“Hello. Eat well, fight well. That's my motto.”
“Ah, hello. I saved you a nice cut.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_cartogr: “Hello, explorer! Need a map?”
“Welcome. The world is bigger than you think.”
“Greetings! I've mapped every hill for miles.”
“Hello. Looking for something hidden? I know where.”
“Ah, a traveler. Tell me where you've been.”
“Welcome. I have maps to places you wouldn't believe.”
“Hello! Ocean monuments, woodland mansions, take your pick.”
“Greetings. Bring me paper and I'll make it worth your while.”
“Hello. Don't get lost now. Buy a map.”
“Welcome, adventurer. The edges of the world await.”
“Ah, hello. My ink is still wet on this one.”
“Hello. I drew you on my map. Tiny, but it's you.”
“Greetings. Every map tells a story.”
“Hello! Banners to mark your way?”
“Welcome. North is that way. Probably.”
“Hello. Glass panes for my windows? I'd pay well.”
“Greetings, friend. Ever seen a mansion in the dark forest?”
“Hello. I've never actually left the village. Shh.”
“Ah, a fellow explorer. Welcome.”
“Hello. Need a compass? I've got plenty.”
“Blessings upon you, traveler.”
“Welcome. Seek you potions, or wisdom?”
“Greetings, child. The stars watch over you.”
“Hello. Ender pearls, glowstone, redstone. All blessed.”
“Ah, hello. I sensed your arrival.”
“Welcome. Bring me rotten flesh and I'll purify it.”
“Greetings. May your path be well lit.”
“Hello. I've been brewing something strange.”
“Peace be with you, friend.”
“Welcome. Lapis lazuli? Ah, the gem of wisdom.”
“Hello. The brewing stand bubbles with promise.”
“Greetings, seeker. What troubles you?”
“Ah, a lost soul. Welcome.”
“Hello. Bottles o' enchanting, freshly made.”
“Welcome. Zombie flesh is quite useful, you know.”
“Greetings. I've seen omens in the clouds.”
“Hello. Nether wart? Bring me some if you find it.”
“Blessings, traveler. Stay safe in the dark.”
“Hello. I pray for your safe return.”
“Ah, welcome. The rabbit's foot brings luck.”
“Hello! Fresh crops, straight from the field.”
“Welcome! Mind the wheat, it's almost ready.”
“Greetings! Bring me carrots, I'll pay emeralds.”
“Hello. Bread, pies, cookies. Take your pick.”
“Ah, a visitor. Hungry?”
“Welcome to the farm. Don't step on the farmland.”
“Hello! My pumpkins are the biggest in the land.”
“Greetings. Got any potatoes? I'm running low.”
“Hello, friend. The harvest was good this year.”
“Welcome. Golden carrots, for the fancy folk.”
“Hello! Beetroot? I've got plenty.”
“Greetings. Melons, sweet and juicy.”
“Ah, hello. Bonemeal makes everything grow faster.”
“Hello. I've got dirt under my nails and I'm proud of it.”
“Welcome. Pumpkin pie, fresh from the oven.”
“Hello! You look like a wheat person.”
“Greetings. Sun, water, and patience. That's farming.”
“Hello. Rabbits keep eating my carrots.”
“Welcome, friend. Want an apple?”
“Ah, hello. The composter's been busy.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_fisherm: “Hello! The fish are biting today.”
“Welcome. Smell that? Fresh cod.”
“Greetings, traveler. Need a fishing rod?”
“Hello. Bring me string and coal, I'll make it worth it.”
“Ah, a visitor. Do you fish?”
“Welcome! Salmon, cod, or something exotic?”
“Hello. I caught a boot this morning. Want it?”
“Greetings. Tropical fish? I love the colors.”
“Hello! Campfires for cooking your catch.”
“Welcome. Patience is the secret to fishing.”
“Ah, hello. You scared away my fish.”
“Hello! A boat is a fisherman's best friend.”
“Greetings. I've seen things in the deep water.”
“Hello. Pufferfish? Don't eat those raw.”
“Welcome, friend. The ocean provides.”
“Hello. I've got an enchanted rod, if you're interested.”
“Greetings. My barrel is full of fish.”
“Hello! The river's calm today.”
“Ah, hello. Ever caught a treasure? I have.”
“Welcome. Smells fishy around here. That's me.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_fletche: “Hello! Arrows, bows, crossbows. Ready for battle?”
“Welcome. My arrows fly true.”
“Greetings! Bring me sticks and I'll pay you.”
“Hello. Feathers? Flint? I'll take them.”
“Ah, an archer. I can tell by your stance.”
“Welcome. Tipped arrows, for special occasions.”
“Hello! A good bow is a work of art.”
“Greetings. Tripwire hooks, too, if you need them.”
“Hello. Skeletons wish they had my arrows.”
“Welcome, hunter. What are we hunting today?”
“Ah, hello. Careful, those arrows are sharp.”
“Hello! Crossbows are all the rage now.”
“Greetings. Straight shafts and sharp points.”
“Hello. I fletch every arrow by hand.”
“Welcome. Strings? I always need strings.”
“Hello! Want a bow with a little magic in it?”
“Greetings, marksman. Show me your aim.”
“Hello. Don't point that bow at me, please.”
“Ah, welcome. The best arrows in the realm.”
“Hello. Targets are on sale today.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_leather: “Hello! Need a new tunic?”
“Welcome. Fine leather, finely stitched.”
“Greetings! Bring me leather and I'll pay you.”
“Hello. A saddle? I've got one for you.”
“Ah, a customer. Your boots look worn.”
“Welcome. Dyed leather, any color you like.”
“Hello! Horse armor, made with love.”
“Greetings. Rabbit hide makes the softest gloves.”
“Hello. I can smell the cauldron from here. Sorry.”
“Welcome, traveler. Leather never goes out of style.”
“Ah, hello. Flint? I need flint for my tools.”
“Hello! Leather pants are very fashionable.”
“Greetings. Scutes? Bring me turtle scutes.”
“Hello. Every stitch is perfect.”
“Welcome. Light armor for quick feet.”
“Hello! A leather cap suits you.”
“Greetings, friend. Bundles are my specialty now.”
“Hello. The cows aren't happy about my job.”
“Ah, welcome. Tanned this batch myself.”
“Hello. Rabbit hide, rabbit hide. Always rabbit hide.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_librari: “Hello. Please speak quietly in the library.”
“Welcome. Seeking knowledge?”
“Greetings. I have enchanted books, if you're interested.”
“Hello. Bring me paper and I'll be grateful.”
“Ah, a reader. Welcome.”
“Welcome. Mending? Unbreaking? Let's see.”
“Hello. Shh. Books are sleeping.”
“Greetings, scholar. What shall we learn today?”
“Hello. I've read every book in this village. Twice.”
“Welcome. Bookshelves, lanterns, clocks. I have them all.”
“Ah, hello. Mind the ink.”
“Hello! A name tag? Very useful.”
“Greetings. Knowledge is the greatest treasure.”
“Hello. Ink sacs, please. I always run out.”
“Welcome. My lectern is my pride and joy.”
“Hello. Ever read a book about yourself?”
“Greetings. Compasses and maps are the cartographer's job, not mine.”
“Hello. Glass? For my reading spectacles, of course.”
“Ah, welcome. Sit, read, but don't fold the pages.”
“Hello. I've been waiting for someone curious.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_mason.3: “Greetings! Bring me clay and I'll pay you well.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_mason.5: “Ah, a builder. I can tell by your hands.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_mason.6: “Welcome. Quartz pillars for a fancy house?”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_mason.8: “Greetings. Every great castle starts with one block.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_mason.1: “Welcome, builder. What are we making today?”
“Welcome. A good wall keeps the zombies out.”
“Hello. I built half this village myself.”
“Ah, welcome. Bricks are my love language.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_mason.2: “Hello. Need a block of quartz? Two?”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_shepher: “Hello! Fresh wool, all colors.”
“Welcome. My sheep are the fluffiest.”
“Greetings! Bring me wool, I'll pay you.”
“Hello. A bed? I've got beds in every color.”
“Ah, a visitor. Want a painting?”
“Welcome. Carpets for your floors?”
“Hello! Shears are the shepherd's best tool.”
“Greetings. Pink sheep are rare, you know.”
“Hello. Banners, made from my finest wool.”
“Welcome, friend. Mind the sheep.”
“Ah, hello. Dye? I need lots of dye.”
“Hello! A soft bed for a tired traveler.”
“Greetings. My sheep have names. All of them.”
“Hello. The loom is singing today.”
“Welcome. White wool is classic.”
“Hello! Want to pet a sheep? They're friendly.”
“Greetings. Paintings to brighten your home.”
“Hello. The wolves keep eyeing my flock.”
“Ah, welcome. Lambs are so adorable.”
“Hello. Woolly, warm, and wonderful.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_toolsmi: “Welcome. My tools never break. Well, rarely.”
“Ah, a miner. I can tell by the dust.”
“Welcome. A diamond pickaxe? I have one.”
“Hello! Bells? Yes, I make those too.”
“Welcome, worker. What are you digging today?”
“Hello! Enchanted tools, for the serious crafter.”
“Hello! Want to see my smithing table?”
“Ah, welcome. Hammer and tongs, that's me.”
“Hello. Need your tools repaired? Buy new ones.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_weapons: “Hello! Need a sword?”
“Welcome. My blades are the sharpest.”
“Greetings! Bring me iron and I'll pay you.”
“Hello. Axes for battle, not for trees.”
“Ah, a warrior. Welcome.”
“Welcome. Enchanted swords, if you've got the emeralds.”
“Hello! A good blade is a fighter's soul.”
“Greetings. Pillagers fear my swords.”
“Hello. Careful, everything here is sharp.”
“Welcome, fighter. Who are we fighting today?”
“Ah, hello. The grindstone is working hard.”
“Hello! A diamond sword? Only the best for you.”
“Greetings. Never leave home without a weapon.”
“Hello. I forge each blade by hand.”
“Welcome. Flint and coal, please.”
“Hello! Want to test the edge? Don't.”
“Greetings, warrior. Show me your swing.”
“Hello. Iron swords are reliable.”
“Ah, welcome. Battle ready, always.”
“Hello. Need a blade for zombies? I've got one.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.ambient_armor: “I wonder if the golem needs armor.”
“My blast furnace is the hottest in town.”
“I made a diamond chestplate once. Beautiful.”
“My arms ache from all this hammering.”
“Netherite. One day, I'll work with netherite.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.ambient_carto: “I think I drew that river wrong.”
“North is that way. Or that way.”
“Glass panes. I need more glass panes.”
“I should map the dark forest someday.”
“The ocean is so big. So big.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.ambient_cleri: “I dreamed of the End last night.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.ambient_farme: “I love the smell of fresh soil.”
“Rain would be nice for the crops.”
“I've been bending over all day. My back hurts.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.ambient_fishe: “I wonder what lives in the deep ocean.”
“Tropical fish are too pretty to eat.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.ambient_libra: “I've lost my place in the book.”
“Who put this book on the wrong shelf?”
“I wonder what's in the stronghold library.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.ambient_sheph: “I need to shear the white one.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.ambient_weapo: “A good sword is a good friend.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.6: “I give discounts to friends. Are we friends?”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.8: “Don't haggle, please. It hurts my feelings.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.11: “Hmm. You have an eye for quality.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.14: “My prices are the best in the land.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.21: “Don't touch it unless you're buying it.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.23: “I could go a little lower. No, I couldn't.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.26: “The emeralds go in the left slot.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.30: “You're my best customer today. My only customer, too.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.32: “Take a look at the second one.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.34: “I've got more in the back. Not really.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.37: “Prices go up when the golem's watching.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.40: “I'll throw in a smile for free.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.42: “Hurry up, I'm closing soon. Just kidding.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.43: “Buy two, and I'll be twice as happy.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.45: “Trade with me and you won't regret it.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.47: “Let me know if you need anything.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.54: “That one's been sitting there a while. Cheap!”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.59: “I've been saving that one for you.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.66: “I'd buy that if I were you.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.83: “Don't tell the others about this price.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.84: “I'm getting better at this every day.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.89: “Hmm. You've got emeralds, I've got goods.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade.91: “Did you know I make these myself?”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.trade_yes.72: “Hmm. A good deal for both of us.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.death.19: “Tell the librarian to return my book.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.death.30: “I was so close to master level.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.death.49: “I'll see you on the other side.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.death.59: “Tell the farmer his pie was good.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.cured.6: “I don't want brains anymore. Good sign.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.cured.7: “My skin isn't green! Wait, it never was.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.cured.8: “You brought me back. I owe you.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.cured.13: “I'll give you the best prices forever.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.cured.18: “I'm not hungry for flesh anymore. Phew.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.cured.24: “Thank you for not giving up on me.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.cured.28: “Let me hug you! Wait, I still smell funny.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.greet_indoors: “Make yourself at home. But not too at home.”
“Mind the bed, I just made it.”
“Hello. Did you close the door behind you?”
“Welcome. It's not much, but it's home.”
“Hello. That's my bed, by the way.”
“Ah, hello. Warm in here, isn't it?”
“Welcome. Stay as long as you like.”
“Hello. Please don't dig through my floor.”
“Ah, a guest. I'll put the kettle on. If I had one.”
“Hello. Are you lost? This is a bedroom.”
“Welcome. Stay out of the rain in here.”
subtitles.talkingvillagers.ambient_indoo: “Did you just look in my chest?”
“You're welcome to stay. For a bit.”
“I should add more torches in here.”
“I like having a roof over my head.”
“Are you going to stay the night?”
“Hmm. Do you hear rain on the roof?”
“Do you like what I've done with the place?”
“I keep my emeralds hidden in here. Somewhere.”
“I should put in a second bed.”
“Can you fix the roof while you're here?”
“Don't stand so close to the door.”
